children: RIYADH — From the shores of the Red Sea stretching westward, through historical and cultural sites, to mountain highlands and modern urban destinations, Saudi Arabia’s tourism map continues to expand, offering a diverse range of products and experiences.

Visitors can explore options that combine the sea, nature, heritage, culture, and entertainment, within a sector witnessing rapid growth in both the number of destinations and the diversity of experiences.

This diversity is evident in the tremendous participation of companies and entities operating in Saudi Arabia’s tourism sector at the “Spotlight” World Travel Market exhibition held from Tuesday to Thursday in Riyadh. The three-day event brought together leading travel and tourism industry leaders, investors, and specialists from around the world on a platform showcasing market developments, tourism products, and opportunities available to companies and investors.

Participation in the exhibition reflected the expanding scope of the local tourism product. Options are no longer tied to a single season or mode of travel but now extend across marine, mountain, cultural, heritage, and recreational tourism, in addition to events, leisure, and hospitality tourism, supported by the emergence of new destinations and projects that have contributed to reshaping Saudi Arabia’s tourism map.

At the “Saudi, Welcome to Arabia” pavilion, these products converge in a comprehensive picture of destinations and experiences available across the Kingdom, from coasts and islands to mountains, oases, and historical sites, as well as cities and the events, museums, cultural and entertainment centers, shopping experiences, and hospitality offerings they host.
This diversity enhances the sector’s ability to develop more

integrated tourism products and programs, while giving travel, hospitality, and investment companies greater scope to develop services that cater to visitors’ varying interests, alongside growing partnerships with international markets and the increasing presence of Saudi destinations at specialized exhibitions and platforms.

This comes as Saudi Arabia’s tourism sector continues to expand its destinations, hospitality facilities, products, and services, strengthening the Kingdom’s presence on the international tourism map and supporting efforts to transform growing interest in Saudi destinations into tourist flows, partnerships, and new investment opportunities under the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
The exhibition as a whole reflects the Kingdom’s expanding
tourism presence and the diversity of its products and destinations, serving as a gathering place for tourism industry leaders, investors, and travel companies from international markets.

It also provides a window into the Kingdom’s natural, cultural, and entertainment assets, as well as developments in its hospitality, services, and experiences ecosystem, enhancing the sector’s competitiveness and opening broader avenues for partnerships, investment, and tourist flows from around the world.

title: ZAWYA: Saudi Arabia strengthens its presence on global tourism map as World Travel Market concludes in Riyadh
